PostgreSQL 15 projects were failing to load /usr/lib/postgresql/15/lib/supautils.so because GLIBC_2.33 is unavailable on affected hosts.
This disrupted database access in multiple regions. 
Rollback is now complete and we are seeing access restored to projects in the affected regions.

This incident has been resolved. A recent API Gateway deployment altered how certain special characters in S3 object key paths were encoded before reaching storage, causing signature verification failures (403) for affected requests.

The change has been reverted and issue is now fixed.

incidents.body:
Capacity availability and project creation, resize, and restart operations have returned to normal and have remained stable for an extended period of time. We are resolving this incident.

Out of an abundance of caution, and out of respect for the impact this incident had for our users, we held the incident open for a considerable amount of time after the observed impact was mitigated. We wanted to be certain any residual potential impact was fully cleared before formally resolving the statuspage.
